notes.title: Bot Crisis is now free!
notes.content: The game is now free to play!

notes.title: Major Updates
notes.content:
Some of the updates include:
[list]
[*] Voice chat
[*] You can see the number of times the player won in the current room
[*] The bots now move in patterns instead of moving randomly
[*] Some bugs were fixed
[*] Guests can now include their name
[/list]

notes.title: We Added A New Minigame! 🥳🥳🥳
notes.content:
We added a new minigame to Bot Crisis. You can find it in the lobby and challenge it to get a lot of gems!

Watch this youtube video: [url=https://youtube.com/shorts/cWM11O3z3hA]https://youtube.com/shorts/cWM11O3z3hA[/url]

notes.title: Fix Connection Issues
notes.content: Today there has been much more disconnections than usual. We have fixed this issue and will improve it even further soon. If you continue to face issues in the game, please contact us at support@codya.co.

notes.title: Bot Crisis Major Update! New Levels and other improvements!
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] New levels
[*] Fix connection issues
[*] The game rules have changed. Now each game has several rounds, and each player has several life points
[*] In-game shop
[*] New hats
[*] Add abilities
[*] Other improvements and fixes
[/olist]
